experiment: Battery degradation proxy in dispatch objective
research_question: How does a linear battery-throughput penalty in the CVXPY objective affect annual operating cost, battery cycling, BLAST-Lite q, and remaining capacity?
external_degradation_evaluation: BLAST-Lite evaluates each resulting annual SOC trajectory using the same second-life entry battery state and temperature profile.
important_boundaries: The linear throughput penalty is a dispatch proxy and is not equivalent to BLAST-Lite degradation.
The selected coefficients are scenario values, not experimentally calibrated battery replacement costs.
Community loads, solar, and prices remain synthetic for this comparison.
The analysis uses a cell-level BLAST-Lite model.
